name: example-wave
description: One track: fast_tests.py --changed follows imports through shared modules.

tracks.title: fast_tests.py --changed follows indirect imports
tracks.brief: fast_tests.py --changed selects the test files that import or name a changed module, but not the tests that reach it through another module, so a change to harness_common.py or portalock.py selects too little. Make --changed follow imports transitively inside .harness/bin, with a guard against import cycles. Add tests to .harness/tests/test_fast_tests.py that change a shared module in a throwaway tree and assert that its indirect dependents are selected. Edit only fast_tests.py and test_fast_tests.py.
